headline: Quantinuum H2 delivered to RIKEN Japan; Helios IPO filing; Singapore partnership
details: In Apr 2026: H2 delivered to RIKEN (Japan) for Reimei-Fugaku hybrid quantum-supercomputer. Quantinuum confidentially filed S-1 for IPO (Feb 2026). Singapore National Quantum Office strategic partnership announced. Helios still flagship: 98 physical / 94 logical qubits, 99.921% 2Q fidelity. Research access via application.
relevance_reason: Helios is our primary target for running MERA circuits (already in QCUP application). New RIKEN deployment means second Quantinuum site with H2 access. IPO filing signals commercial scaling.
access_path: QCUP PHY204 (declined, resubmit after SciPost publication). Direct Helios application at quantinuum.com. H2 via RIKEN collaboration (academic route).
